claims.statement: The build script runs `tsc -b` before `vite build`, so a TypeScript project-reference type check must pass before Vite produces the production bundle.

vite.config.ts registers both @vitejs/plugin-react and @vanilla-extract/vite-plugin's vanillaExtractPlugin(), which together enable JSX/Fast Refresh handling and build-time compilation of .css.ts files.
App.css.ts defines vanilla-extract style objects (card, logo) including a :hover pseudo-class inside the style() call, and App.tsx imports them to set className props.
Global styles are kept in a plain .css file (src/app/styles/index.css) rather than vanilla-extract, so component-scoped styles use .css.ts while global styles use .css.

tsconfig.json contains no files of its own and only wires tsconfig.app.json (src app code, bundler module resolution, noEmit) and tsconfig.node.json (vite.config.ts under a Node typing context) as project references.
.oxlintrc.json enables the react, typescript, and oxc oxlint plugins, sets react/rules-of-hooks to error, and sets react/only-export-components to warn with allowConstantExport.
